_comment: The FinMont-demo subject sidecar. Everything the pipeline needs to know about
THIS body of law lives here. All paths are repo-root-relative.
PROVENANCE, which this subject splits and which NOTES.md §3 sets out in full:
PRIMARY, supplied and quoted throughout -- Commission Delegated Regulation
(EU) 2018/389 (the PSD2 SCA-RTS), OJ L 69, 13.3.2018, p. 23. This is the
instrument named in `citation` and reachable at `source_url`.
SECONDARY, NOT supplied -- Directive (EU) 2015/2366 (PSD2) Arts 71-77 and
89-92, for the refund deadlines and the liability shift, which the SCA-RTS
does not contain at all. Encoded in psd2-refunds-and-liability.l4 and in
three of the five scope gates in finmont-sca-orchestration.l4, with every
affected @ref carrying an UNVERIFIED marker.
status is "draft" for exactly that reason: the encoding exists and no claim of
fidelity is made. It cannot move to "adversarially-reviewed" until the
Directive text is deposited as a source bundle and every UNVERIFIED marker has
been discharged against it.
encoding.state is "written": all five modules exist at the paths below.
encoding.main is the firm-facing entry-point module; the two law modules and
the domain it imports are listed in corpus_modules.
checks floors are 0/0 DELIBERATELY, so the corresponding sub-checks report NOT
CHECKED rather than vacuously green. They are floors, not counts, and must be
MEASURED figures from `l4 run --json` -- not a count of '#ASSERT' strings in
the source. No jl4 CLI was available in this environment (the tree carries
jl4-lsp only), so nothing here has been machine-evaluated and no floor has been
earned. Raise them from a real run before this subject is relied on. The source
carries 82 assertions and 2 #EVAL directives across the three rule modules and
the case file, and 2 dated arms on Art 38(2) and Art 38(3), which is what a
first run should be reconciled against.
'legs' is deliberately EMPTY. The driver declares a projection stage IFF the
leg is declared here, so an omitted leg is a stage that never runs and never
reports -- an honest silence. No DMN or BPMN projection has been emitted.
There is no gates/ directory. No human gate has been granted; an absent gate
directory is an honest statement that nobody has signed, where a stub would not
be.
